text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with information in regards to outstanding claims between TO Live/City of Toronto and Ferncastle.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Received the report (October 31, 2019) from the City Solicitor for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (October 31, 2019) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice or communications that are subject to solicitor-client privilege or which are the subject matter of litigation or contemplated litigation.
